start.text:
[TODO:es] The elders cry, "Give us a king!"
Samuel turns to the Lord in grief.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A king is given, not seized.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The Lord answers in His time.

crown_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Wait on the Lord
crown_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Crowns of pride do not last.
Let God choose His king.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Honor the Prophet
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Samuel speaks for the Lord.
Wait with him in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

warning.title: [TODO:es] The Cost of a King
warning.text:
[TODO:es] "He will take your sons and fields."
The people still cry for one.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His words are for you too.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Quiet Your Voice
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Listen before you answer.
The prophet speaks for God.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You let his words sink deep.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay and Hear
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] These words will shape your life.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You step back to the circle.

lost_path.title: [TODO:es] Father's Donkeys Are Lost
lost_path.text:
[TODO:es] Days of searching, hills of dust.
A servant says, "There is a seer here."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Press Onward
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your search is more than donkeys.
Go to the seer.

pay_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Greater Than Coin
pay_consequence.text:
Él no necesita tu plata.
Ve y escucha su palabra.

anointing.title: Aceite sobre tu cabeza
anointing.text:
Samuel derrama aceite y te besa.
«El Señor te ha escogido para liderar».

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:es] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:es] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.title: Inclínate primero
boast_consequence.text:
La corona es pesada con el llamado.
Recíbela con humildad.

reject_consequence.title: No te niegues
reject_consequence.text:
Dios mismo unge a través de Samuel.
Recibe lo que se te da.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands rest open at your side.

assembly.title: Las tribus se reúnen en Mizpa
assembly.text:
Las suertes caen y tu nombre es llamado.
La gente busca en el campamento.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] God will still bring you out.

demand_consequence.title: Sirve primero
demand_consequence.text:
Un rey de Israel sirve al Señor.
Da un paso adelante con humildad.

hide_consequence.title: Encontrado entre los cántaros
hide_consequence.text:
Te sacan a la luz.
Tu llamado no puede ser escondido.

confirmation.title: «¡Viva el rey!»
confirmation.text:
Las tribus gritan y se inclinan ante ti.
Un nuevo camino se abre a tus pies.
